race.comment: BLANC VISAGE (10) has hit the line strongly in each of her 2 starts back from a spell, and she will notice the drop in class for this. She has won her only starts here over the trip, and should be hard to hold out. RAMASIS (2) ran boldly fresh up, but had an excuse for a modest effort at Murray Bridge nearly 3 weeks ago. She slides down in class, and is worth another chance, especially from the pole position. SANTASTICO (1) likes to run along in front, and with the aid of a 2kg claim, he will once again take some pegging back. VOLTAGE POINT (9) was not far away from the placings fresh up in stronger company at Morphettville nearly a fortnight ago, and he can be a quick improver at some each-way value.
